_doc: The Pale Rim's white shallows (Ch16, M4-A2P-056; docs/kb/plan/act2/creatures/rim_ray.md): small pale rays in loose groups gliding over the white sand a hand of water deep (the sand's top y 0, the surface y 0.1: they swim at y 0.04, flat), beside the wade's cairns so the party passes them: by Cairn0, Cairn2 and Cairn4, each group off the line on the side away from its cairn. A wader within startle_radius_m sends a group gliding off. Placed on the greybox layout (pale_rim_layout.json).
